body.message:
Here's the proposed decomposition of **prd/001-split-seam-cast-shadow.md**. This is a single, cohesive CSS + interaction change to one seam, so I'm proposing one parent issue with a single Sandcastle child (no sibling dependencies).

---

## Parent issue (never labeled Sandcastle)

**Title:** Cast-shadow seam between editor and preview

**Body:**

> **[decomposer · claude-code · claude-opus-4-8]**
>
> Replaces the thick 5px `.split-divider` bar in dual-pane mode with the folder-pane seam treatment — a 1px hairline plus a soft inset cast shadow (reusing `--mm-panel-shadow`) — so the preview appears to float in front of the editor, mirroring the folder→workspace seam. Resize-by-drag, double-click-to-reset, and the `col-resize` cursor are preserved via an invisible ~8px grab zone; an accent tint appears only on hover/drag. Scope is split mode only, no new theme variable, and no change to layout order, resize math, or ratio persistence.
>
> **PRD:** prd/001-split-seam-cast-shadow.md

---

## Child 1 (labeled `Sandcastle`) — no blockers

**Title:** Replace split divider with hairline + cast-shadow seam

**Acceptance criteria** (lifted from the PRD Requirements):

- In split mode, the editor↔preview separator renders as the folder-pane seam treatment: a 1px hairline (`--mm-border`) plus an inset cast shadow, replacing the current 5px `--mm-border` bar.
- The shadow is cast leftward — an inset shadow on the editor pane's right edge — so the preview appears to float in front of the editor, geometrically mirroring `.folder-panel::after`.
- The shadow reads from the existing `--mm-panel-shadow` variable with the same default value as the folder seam; no new theme variable is introduced.
- Resizing is preserved via an invisible grab zone over the seam (~8px wide) that keeps a `col-resize` cursor and drag-to-resize; double-click still resets the split to 50/50.
- At rest the seam shows only the hairline + shadow; a subtle accent tint appears **only** while hovering or dragging the grab zone.
- The effect applies only in split (dual-pane) mode; single-pane editor-only and preview-only views are unchanged.
- The seam and its depth cue read correctly in both light and dark themes, consistent with the folder seam.
- The resize handle element keeps its `data-testid="split-divider"` and pointer/double-click behavior so existing interaction tests continue to target it.

---

Reply **APPROVED** to create this tree, or send feedback to revise. If you'd like me to hold the release (create the child without the `Sandcastle` label), say so.

Created the issue tree for prd/001-split-seam-cast-shadow.md:

**Parent #6** — Cast-shadow seam between editor and preview (unlabeled)
  └─ **Child #7** — Replace split divider with hairline + cast-shadow seam  [Sandcastle · no blockers]

#7 is linked as a GitHub sub-issue of #6. The labeled child will be picked up by the next `npm run sandcastle` run. Decompose issue #5 is left open — the script closes it.
